{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"A structured blazer in charcoal grey with a sharp shoulder line and notched lapel, medium length hitting just above the hip, cut from a durable wool-blend twill with a matte finish.
A tailored straight-leg trouser in dark indigo denim that falls to the ankle, featuring a clean front without distressing, crafted from sturdy cotton with a slight stretch for comfort during movement.
A fitted crewneck blouse in cream white made of smooth poplin fabric that drapes neatly under the blazer, providing a soft contrast to the structured outer layers.
Minimalist gold hoop earrings in polished brass to add a touch of subtle elegance without being distracting in a professional setting.
A sleek leather tote bag in black with a structured base and one main compartment, sized to hold a laptop and interview essentials while maintaining a polished silhouette.
Low-top ankle boots in smooth black leather with a modest block heel and a rounded toe, offering stability and ease of walking through the office floors.

This outfit works because it strikes the perfect balance between professional polish and approachable casualness required for an entry-level analyst role at a tech startup. The blazer and denim combination adheres to the 'everyday' formality band while signaling readiness for a morning interview in autumn weather, as no outer coat is needed above 20°C or if it remains cool indoors.
